caption:
This editorial illustration for the magazine "TEMPO" features a caricature of a man sitting in the corner of a room. The man has a large head relative to his body and wears thin-rimmed spectacles. He is shown hunched over, sitting on a tiled floor with his knees drawn up toward his chest. His right hand is raised to his mouth, with his thumb near his lips. He wears a bright yellow jacket over a dark suit and a white shirt. His expression is wide-eyed and tense. The background consists of dark blue walls meeting at a corner and a light-colored, checkered tile floor.

Large yellow text on the right side reads "AKBAR TERPOJOK SIAPA SENANG". Above the main magazine title "TEMPO" in large white letters, a red banner contains the text "Wawancara Agus Budiman, Korban Kepanikan AS?". Small text below the main title reads "EDISI 26 November - 2 Desember 2001". A barcode and the price "Rp 10.800" are visible at the bottom. The man is positioned centrally, taking up much of the lower left and middle portions of the frame.

An editorial illustration for the magazine "TEMPO" features a light tan background with a red border. Large red serif text at the top reads "TEMPO". Above this, a red bar contains white and yellow text: "Sulitnya Memburu Azahari di Bandung". Below the main title, smaller blue text reads "EDISI 3-9 November 2003". The main headline in large black sans-serif font is "Skandal BNI, Siapa Menikmati?".

Below the text, six rodents of various colors—white, black, gray, and brown—are shown on and around a fragmented blue and orange logo. The logo consists of a large, jagged teal shape resembling a stylized "B" or sail, with a smaller orange curved piece and three teal wavy lines below it. The rodents are chewing on or crawling over the pieces. A white mouse is at the top left, a large black rat at the top center, and a gray rat at the right. A brown mouse is on the left, and another black rat and a green-tinged rat are at the bottom right. At the bottom, a barcode and the text "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN" and "Rp 14.700" are visible.

This magazine cover illustration features ten individuals depicted as caricatures wearing white togas. The composition is divided horizontally by a curved white architectural ledge. 

Above the ledge, eight men are positioned in a group. On the left, one man laughs with raised hands while another has his arm around him. In the center, a man with a mustache looks down towards a man resting his head on his hand. To the right, two men are whispering, one holding a gold-colored goblet. A man on the far left holds a sealed envelope, while another holds a scroll.

Below the ledge, a woman with dark hair and glasses faces a man with graying hair. Both wear white togas and are seen from the waist up.

The background shows a tall, fluted column. The large red text "TEMPO" dominates the upper center. Other legible text includes "JARINGAN INTERNASIONAL PEMBOBOL ATM," "PANSUS CENTURY: SIAPA JADI KORBAN," and "EDISI 1-7 FEBRUARI 2010." A yellow circle in the upper left corner contains text starting with "BANK DAERAH." A barcode and "Rp 24.700" are at the bottom.

This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large white serif letters. Above the title, smaller yellow text reads "WAWANCARA" followed by a small square inset photograph of a man with glasses and a beard, and "UMBERTO ECO". Below the title, text reads "EDISI 24-30 Oktober 2011". Large yellow sans-serif text in the center reads "Opera Sabun Kocok Kabinet".

The central figure is a man seen from behind, wearing a blue suit. He has many arms extending from his torso. One pair of arms is raised; the right hand holds a thin baton. Two arms extend sideways with open palms. Another hand on the left holds a white quill pen. A hand on the right holds a silver-topped cane. Two hands are tied behind his back with a red rope. He stands before a row of six massive, smooth white columns. A barcode, price "Rp 27.000", and "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN" are at the bottom. Small vertical text on the left margin includes "ISSN: 0126 - 4273" and a website URL.

A vertical rectangular image shows a magazine cover with a black background and red borders on the left and bottom edges. At the top, the red word "TEMPO" is centered in large, bold, serif font. Below it, small white text reads "EDISI 7-13 MEI 2012". Above the main title, smaller white text sections are separated by vertical lines: "MAIN SABUN BBM BERSUBSIDI", a small square portrait of a person with dark hair and glasses, "MENGINTIP ANGIE DI RUTAN KPK", and "MEMBURU NENENG DI PELARIAN".

The center features large, three-tiered text. The top line in gray reads "CERITA DARI". The middle line in larger gray reads "KAMPUNG". The bottom line is the largest, in white, textured block letters: "NARKOBA". A thin black horizontal line cuts through the center of the white letters. On the right, a hand's fingers hold a rolled-up red and white paper tube, positioned as if to draw the black line through the letters.

Below, white text states: "BERTAHUN-TAHUN KAMPUNG AMBON MENJADI PASAR NARKOTIK DI IBU KOTA. KUAT DIDUGA APARAT TERLIBAT." The bottom left includes "RP 29.700", website and publication info, and a white barcode box.

This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. A central caricature depicts a light-skinned man with short dark hair and a receding hairline. He wears a tan, short-sleeved collared shirt with epaulets and brown trousers secured by a white belt. Seated on a large grey motorcycle, he looks back over his right shoulder. His right hand grips a handlebar; his left foot, in a dark boot, rests on a grey platform. The motorcycle features a large rear tire, a dual exhaust pipe, and a black license plate. 

The motorcycle and man are positioned in front of a large flat-screen monitor displaying a grey winding road under a cloudy sky. Two signs on this road read "KPK" in red and black letters. A grey pole supports the monitor.

The background is a textured lavender-grey. Text at the top reads "LIPUTAN KHUSUS" and "JARINGAN RAJA TAMBANG BATU BARA" in yellow. The large white masthead says "TEMPO". Below it, text reads "EDISI 6-12 AGUSTUS 2012". On the left, large white text reads "SIMSALABIM JENDERAL SIM". The Bottom-left corner displays pricing, a website, and a barcode. Bottom-right text identifies "Inspektur Jenderal Djoko Susilo".

An editorial illustration depicts the head and torso of a man in profile, facing right. He wears a black peaked cap and a tan collared garment with a black tie. His face and neck are rendered in tan, white, and black tones with sharp, angular shadows. A red, dripping shape appears on his neck, and a similar red stain marks his left shoulder.

The background is a textured, mottled beige and brown surface. Large red capital letters spelling "TEMPO" span the top center. Below this, smaller black text reads "EDISI 12-18 NOVEMBER 2012". To the right, red and black text reads "SOEDIRMAN SEORANG PANGLIMA, SEORANG MARTIR" above the red words "LAPORAN KHUSUS." A small white circle in the lower right contains the text "POSTER INFOGRAFIS BLITZKRIEG VS GERILYA." 

The top edge features white text: "DI BALIK AUDIT HAMBALANG | LAPORAN TEMPO DARI SURIAH." In the bottom left, a barcode, number "00037," "RP 29.700," a website address, and other small text are visible. The man’s gaze is directed upward and to the right.

This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large, white, serif capital letters. The background is a dense, lush green landscape of tropical trees and foliage, covering almost the entire frame. Nestled within this thick greenery is a two-story structure with a brown tiled roof and white walls. A smaller, gazebo-like structure with a similar roof stands slightly lower and to the left of the main building.

Various lines of text are superimposed on the image. At the top left, yellow text reads "GERTAK SAMBAL ANAS URBANINGRUM." To the top right, yellow text reads "SKENARIO KREDIT LANCUNG BANK JABAR." Centered below the main title is smaller white text: "EDISI 4-10 MARET 2013." A red rectangular box with the white word "INVESTIGASI" is positioned above large, bold, white capital letters that read "PENGGEDE DI HULU CISADANE." Below this, smaller white text states: "Pejabat, artis, politikus menguasai lahan haram di Kawasan Taman Nasional Gunung Halimun-Salak." At the bottom left, a barcode and the price "RP 33.000" are visible. The left edge of the cover features a solid red vertical stripe.

This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. Centered in the upper portion is the large red word "TEMPO" in a sans-serif font. Above this, white text reads "GAYA MEWAH BUPATI SULA". To the right, smaller white text states "EDISI 24-30 JUNI 2013".

The central image features the front grill and hood of a dark, metallic car. A chrome hood ornament, shaped like a winged figure, sits atop the grill. Below this, yellow text reads "BUNTUT KASUS SIMULATOR KEMUDI", followed by large, bold white text that says "PELAT NOMOR".

A piece of torn, brown corrugated cardboard is affixed over the lower portion of the car's grill. Hand-drawn in black ink on the cardboard are the characters "K 050 NG" and "06.13" in the lower right. A small circular silver screw or fastener is visible on the cardboard. 

In the bottom right corner, a price of "RP 33.000", a website URL, and a barcode with numbers are visible. A red border runs down the left edge of the entire composition.

An editorial illustration for the magazine "TEMPO" features a central portrait of a man with black hair and tan skin. His head is positioned above a large, dark gray police uniform adorned with gold-colored buttons, insignias, and a name tag that reads "SUTARMAN". The uniform includes a white dress shirt and a black necktie. The man’s neck appears to be replaced by a large, upright white collar that curves around his head, creating a gap between the head and the shoulders of the uniform.

The background is a light blue-gray gradient. At the top, the red word "TEMPO" is prominently displayed. Above it, white text reads "GATOT-HOLLY: ANTARA MAUT DAN CINTA / PELESIR RAHASIA AKIL-ATUT". Below the red masthead, smaller white text states "EDISI 21-27 OKTOBER 2013". To the right of the central figure, large black block letters read "KAPOLRI SELERA CIKEAS". In the bottom right corner, there is a barcode, a price of "RP 33.000", the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN ISSN: 0126 - 4273".

This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white letters. Above the title, smaller black text reads "INVESTIGASI: ANTIKLIMAKS PSSI". Below the title is the date "3-9 MARET 2014". The primary subject is a man with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a dark long-sleeved shirt. He is shown from the waist up, leaning over a gray surface. His right hand is placing a gold crown onto a large white dome-shaped structure, which appears to be part of an LNG tanker constructed from interlocking plastic blocks. 

The ship has a black hull featuring a green and yellow circular logo with the letters "bp". Four large white domes run along the deck of the ship. On the gray surface nearby are scattered small plastic building blocks in red, blue, and gray. To the right of the man, large black text reads "LEGO GAS MENTERI JERO". Beneath this, smaller black text reads "NEGARA BISA RUGI TRILIUNAN RUPIAH DI GAS TANGGUH. LOBI TINGKAT TINGGI PEMERINTAH INGGRIS?". The The bottom right corner shows a barcode, the price "RP 35.000", and the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO".

This vertical editorial illustration features four men positioned behind a white table against a blue background. Across the top, white text reads "TEMPO" below a gray banner containing "EDISI KHUSUS PEMILIHAN PRESIDEN". 

From left to right: a man in a green shirt eats noodles from a white bowl decorated with a black rooster; he holds white chopsticks in his right hand. Beside him, a man in a black cap and orange shirt raises his right fist and holds a small blue container in his left hand. Next, a man in a light blue shirt holds his hands near his chest. On the far right, a man with white hair and a blue shirt raises clenched fists. 

The foreground table holds three additional rooster-motif bowls, two stacked and one separate, along with three white cups with black lids and scattered small brown shapes. 

Large blue text at the bottom reads "BOWO, JOKO, HATTA & KALLA." Smaller text below says "TELITI SEBELUM MEMILIH: YANG LURUS DAN YANG LANCUNG DARI CALON PRESIDEN DAN WAKIL PRESIDEN". A barcode and "RP 35.000" are also visible.

A red magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large black letters features an illustration of several people against a red background. At the top, white text reads "DISKRIMINASI AGAMA-AGAMA LOKAL" and "BIANG KELADI KEBAKARAN HUTAN RIAU." Below the title, the date "27 OKTOBER-2 NOVEMBER 2014" is printed. Large white block letters in the center read "MIMPI KABINET IMPIAN."

The illustration depicts a central man with dark, thinning hair, a tired expression, and downturned eyes. Four other figures surround him, leaning in closely. To his left, a man with a wide-open mouth appears to be shouting into the central man’s ear. To the right, a woman with short dark hair and glasses smiles while holding a rolled-up piece of paper featuring a small face. In the lower left, a woman with dark hair leans towards the central man, and in the lower right, the back of a person’s head and shoulder are visible. All figures wear white shirts. Hands are raised toward the central man’s face. A barcode and price "RP 35.000" are in the bottom right corner.

This editorial illustration features the cover of "TEMPO" magazine dated "2-8 MARET 2015". Centered at the top in large red serif font is the word "TEMPO". Above it, smaller black text reads "TERBANG PILIH MENTERI JONAN" and "MENGAPA PDIP MENGGERGAJI AHOK" separated by a diagonal line.

The main headline, "AGAR KPK MATI SURI", is rendered in large, bold black sans-serif font on the left. Below it, smaller text states: "Satu per satu pendukung KPK dilaporkan ke polisi. Pengakuan eksklusif saksi kasus Novel Baswedan."

The background depicts a multi-story white building labeled "KPK" on its side. Thick, dark grey smoke billows from the top of this building, filling the upper right corner. In the foreground, the upper half of a silver car with a blue and white police light bar is visible. Inside the car, two indistinct figures are visible behind the windshield; the one on the right wears a bright yellow vest. At the bottom left, a barcode sits next to the text "RP 39.500", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN". The entire image is framed by a solid red vertical border on the left.

An editorial illustration features a large gray dump truck with a white cabin against a gray background. A man with tan skin and short dark hair, wearing a white collared shirt, sits in the driver’s seat. The truck's bed is raised at a steep angle, dumping several men out the back. These men wear various colored suits—black, brown, red, and blue—and display expressions of alarm. One man in a red jacket is shown falling head-first. On the side of the truck bed, a colorful vertical bar chart is visible. 

At the top, the large black word "TEMPO" is printed. Above it, white text reads "MAIN MATA BOBOL BANK DKI RP 230 MILIAR" and "ARISAN POSISI DINASTI PEJABAT". Below "TEMPO," the date "29 JUNI-5 JULI 2015" appears. To the left, large white text says "PATAH TUMBUH MENTERI BERGANTI," followed by smaller white text: "Siapa bakal dicopot dari Kabinet Kerja Presiden Jokowi?". The bottom right corner contains a barcode, price "RP 39.500," and "ISSN: 0126-4273." A vertical red stripe borders the left edge.

This magazine cover features a close-up, profile portrait of a man's face facing right. He has dark hair, prominent forehead wrinkles, and dark eyes. Dramatic side lighting illuminates the upper right portions of his face, while the lower left and background remain in dark shadow. Several small moles are visible on his skin. At the bottom, a small section of a collared shirt with an intricate, light-colored pattern is visible.

Text is distributed across the image. At the top is "LIPUTAN KHUSUS SETAHUN PEMERINTAHAN JOKO WIDODO". The title "TEMPO" appears in large, white, serif capital letters across the upper third. Beneath it is "26 OKTOBER-1 NOVEMBER 2015". In the lower right, "DILEMA JOKOWI" is printed in bold white sans-serif text above "Siapa yang selama ini mempengaruhi kebijakan-kebijakan Presiden?". The bottom left includes "RP 39.500", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", "ISSN: 0126 - 4273", and a barcode with the numbers "00035" and "9 770126 427302". The background is dark and indistinct.

An editorial illustration shows a muscular, shirtless man from the back, positioned against a textured blue background. His head is turned slightly to the right, showing his profile. His back features deep, shadowed grooves suggesting musculature or scars. On his lower right back, a red dollar sign symbol is etched or tattooed with a dashed-line effect. A red vertical bar runs along the left edge of the frame.

The illustration contains the following text: "PERSEKONGKOLAN KARTEL AYAM" and "LOBI-LOBI KASUS NOVEL BASWEDAN" at the top. The large red word "TEMPO" is centered above the man. Below it, smaller text reads "15-21 FEBRUARI 2016". To the left of the man, white text reads: "JARINGAN MAKELAR CANGKOK GINJAL" followed by "Diperdagangkan hingga Rp 500 juta per organ, benarkah dokter RSCM terlibat?". At the bottom left, a barcode is visible next to "RP 39.500", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126-4273". The top left corner features a colorful graphic logo with red, yellow, and blue shapes.

This editorial illustration on a magazine cover features several distinct visual elements set against a cream background. At the top, the large red text "TEMPO" dominates, with "PEMAIN IMIGRAN DI PIALAL EROPA" written above it. Centered on the right is the bold black title "PETAK UMPET KILANG TUBAN" followed by smaller descriptive text in Indonesian.

The main graphic depicts a large, stylized arm and hand extending from the left. The arm wears a black sleeve with a white cuff and a white abstract three-point logo. The hand is bright red, with a pointed index finger pressing down on two smaller human figures. These figures, a person in a white cap and orange pants and another in a dark suit, are shown in an active stance, holding their arms upward as if supporting the weight of the giant finger above them. The bottom left corner contains publication details like "6-12 JUNI 2016", "RP 39.500", and a barcode with the numbers "9 770126 427302".

This vertical editorial illustration, which serves as a magazine cover, features a centered large, silver-colored coin shown from an angled perspective. The coin is decorated with the Garuda Pancasila bird emblem, the word "INDONESIA," and the year "2017." A man in a blue business suit and black shoes, holding a brown briefcase, is depicted in mid-air above the coin. He is shown with his arms and legs splayed out in a falling or slipping motion, with his right foot touching the top edge of the coin. The background is a light, textured off-white.

Large grey text reading "TEMPO" is centered at the top, with "MAKELAR REKTOR UNIVERSITAS NEGERI" and "PARA KANDIDAT KETUA PPATK" above it. Below "TEMPO," smaller text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." A logo with "45" and "1971-2016" sits to the left. Below the center-left, bold black text reads "PROSPEK 2017 AGAR EKONOMI TAK LESU DARAH." At the bottom left, a barcode and publication details including "24-30 OKTOBER 2016" and "RP 39.500" are visible against a solid red vertical border.

This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO". The composition features several stylized human figures in a colorful, comic-book style. Six men and one woman are visible from the chest or waist up, arranged in a crowded, overlapping manner.

The central figure is a man in a yellow suit and black tie, smiling widely and looking forward. Surrounding him, other figures in various colorful suits (blue, orange, red, and white) are depicted in profile or three-quarter views. Several figures hold small, rectangular cards with a light-blue border and a red horizontal stripe; some are biting these cards as if they were food. One figure in the upper right has a stern expression, while others appear jovial. The background consists of vertical blocks of color in red, blue, black, green, and orange.

Text on the cover includes "TEMPO" in large white letters across the top. Smaller text at the top reads "BERSIH-BERSIH DI OJK" and "VONIS JANGGAL UNTUK GAFATAR". Large white text at the bottom right reads "PESTA PORA E-KTP", followed by a paragraph in Indonesian beginning with "BANCAKAN KARTU TANDA PENDUDUK ELEKTRONIK...". A red circle contains "TEMPO 46", and a barcode with "13-19 MARET 2017" and "RP 45.000" is at the bottom left.

An editorial illustration on a magazine cover features a waist-up comic-style drawing of a man against a solid blue background. The man has a brown-toned complexion with a pink-dotted texture, dark hair, a mustache, and a short beard. He wears a white turban and a white collared shirt. His expression shows wide eyes and a slight grimace, revealing teeth. He holds a red telephone handset to his ear with both hands; his right ring finger bears a large ring with a red stone. 

At the top, large red letters spell “TEMPO” over white text stating “ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU”. Above this, white text reads “SALING SALIP PEMAIN FINTECH / DUA SEJOLI KORUPSI BENGKULU”. 

A yellow rectangular box in the upper left contains black text: “DARI PERSEMBUNYIANNYA, RIZIEQ SYIHAB MENGIRIM UTUSAN UNTUK MELOBI JOKOWI. GERTAK SAMBAL DARI SAUDI?”. 

A white circular speech bubble near the bottom left contains the bold black text “REKONSILIASI ATAU REVOLUSI !”. 

The bottom left corner includes date and price details: “3-9 JULI 2017”, “RP 45.000”, a website, and a barcode with numbers.

A vertical illustration features a pale-skinned figure wearing a peaked cap with a black top and a red and silver band. The cap's visor is pulled low, obscuring the upper face. The figure wears a light-colored uniform with red and black shoulder epaulettes and black gloves. This figure holds a finger to their lips in a "shush" gesture while cradling a white calf with black patches around its eyes. The figure's gloved hands wrap around the calf's neck and head. 

The background is dark gray with partial, large black letters. In the lower-left, large red text reads "MAIN SETIP DOKUMEN SAPI". Smaller gray text below describes allegations involving "PENYIDIK KPK", "DAGING SAPI", "PEJABAT", "PERWIRA POLISI", and "PATRIALIS AKBAR".

Top headings include "LOBI KERAS PERPU ORMAS" and "ATURAN GANJIL IMPOR TEKSTIL". The bottom-right corner contains a date of "30 OKTOBER-5 NOVEMBER 2017", a price, a website, a barcode, and the number "00036". A solid red border runs along the left edge.

This editorial illustration features a red background with large beige and white text at the top and center. The word "TEMPO" is prominently displayed in a large, serif, beige font. Below it, smaller beige text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." The main headline in large white sans-serif letters is "GALAU JOKOWI." Smaller white text below this describes a search for a vice-presidential candidate.

The foreground contains two male figures shown from different perspectives. On the right, a large profile view of a man's head and shoulders dominates the frame. He has dark hair, tan skin, and is shown resting his chin on his hand in a contemplative pose. He holds three rectangular white cards in his left hand. These cards feature portraits of three different men in varying attire.

On the left, a smaller, full-frontal illustration shows a man with a worried expression, his hand to his chin. He wears a white long-sleeved shirt and holds three playing cards with a blue-and-white patterned back. In the bottom right corner, a barcode, date "5-11 MARET 2018," price "RP 45.000," and other publishing details are visible. Other text at the very top includes "DALAM SERBUAN SABU TAIWAN" and "CALON TUNGGAL GUBERNUR BI."

This portrait-oriented editorial illustration features two large, profile-view human heads, rendered in shades of red and pink. On the left, a figure with short hair and a thick neck faces right with an open-mouthed, laughing expression. On the right, a second figure with a high forehead and visible hair faces left, looking downward with a closed-mouth smile. Below their heads, two large hands meet in the center. The thumbs of these hands are transformed into small human figures from the waist up, each wearing a dark peaked cap with a light-colored emblem. These thumb-figures face each other. The hands below are clasped together.

The background is a solid pale yellow. Red text at the top reads "GERILYA MEMANGKAS KEWENANGAN KPK" and "MATI SURI KAWASAN EKONOMI KHUSUS". Central text in large red capital letters says "PILKADA SERASA PILPRES", followed by smaller black text: "PEMILIHAN GUBERNUR DI EMPAT PROVINSI MENJADI PERTARUHAN KANDIDAT PEMILU PRESIDEN. JAWA MASIH JADI ANDALAN." At the bottom left, a white box contains a barcode and text: "00018 25 JUNI-1 JULI 2018 RP 45.000 WWW.TEMPO.CO MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN ISSN 0126-4273". A large, dark, partially obscured letter sits behind the figures' heads.

An editorial illustration serves as the cover of Tempo magazine, featuring a stylized depiction of an aircraft cockpit in a monochromatic red and black palette. The large word "TEMPO" is centered at the top in a red, serif font. Below it, a dark overhead panel is filled with numerous small, glowing red switches, dials, and indicator lights. A central black pillar divides the view out of two large, blank red windows. 

Across the center, bold white text reads "KOKPIT BUTA JT 610." Smaller white text underneath provides details about a flight system. The lower half of the image displays the main instrument panel, densely packed with illuminated red gauges, buttons, and digital displays. At the bottom left, a white box contains a barcode, the number "00037," and pricing information including "5-11 NOVEMBER 2018," "RP 45.000," and "WWW.TEMPO.CO." At the very top, two headlines in white text flank a diagonal line: "JEJAK SUAP PETINGGI PARTAI AMANAT NASIONAL" and "TERKATUNG-KATUNG KONSUMEN MEIKARTA."

An editorial magazine cover features an illustration of a man with brown skin and dark hair, wearing a brown collared shirt. He is submerged up to his chest inside a large, circular metal tin filled with a thick, viscous, honey-colored substance that clings to his face, hands, and clothes in long, sticky strands. His face shows a strained expression with a slight frown. His right hand rests on the tin's rim, and a gold ring is visible on his ring finger.

The tin has a red and yellow label. Large yellow cursive text on the label reads "Aib Anggaran Anies". Below this, smaller black block text states, "RANCANGAN BUJET DKI JAKARTA BERTABUR PROYEK JANGGAL. GUBERNUR ANIES BASWEDAN DITENGARAI BAKAL BAGI-BAGI DANA HIBAH BUAT PENDUKUNGNYA."

At the top, the masthead "TEMPO" is partially obscured by the man. Above it, black text reads "FAKTA BARU KEMATIAN AKTIVIS LINGKUNGAN / INVESTIGASI: KOMISI OBAT BUAT DOKTER". The bottom left corner contains a barcode and publication details: "11-17 NOVEMBER 2019", "RP 45.000", and "WWW.TEMPO.CO".

This editorial illustration features the cover of "TEMPO" magazine, dated "11-17 MARET 2019." The top section is white with red and black text, including "SIMPANG-SIUR NARKOTIK ANDI ARIEF" and "KRIMINALISASI PENGKRITIK TNI." Below, the large red masthead reads "TEMPO" over the slogan "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU."

The central image occupies the lower two-thirds, set against a pink background with a darker pink halftone dot pattern. A large white speech bubble contains the bold black title "ENAM MENGUAK SENAYAN," followed by a paragraph of smaller black text. The bubble obscures the head of a central figure.

This figure is a person shown from the chest up, wearing a white button-down shirt. The person’s hands are pulling the shirt open to reveal a dark purple t-shirt underneath. On the center of the t-shirt is a gold emblem featuring a bird with spread wings inside a circular wreath, with the text "DPR - RI" on a banner below. The illustration uses a comic-book style with bold outlines and flat colors. In the bottom right corner, there is a barcode, pricing, and publication details.

This portrait-oriented editorial illustration features a grey background with a red vertical stripe on the left. The large black word “TEMPO” is centered at the top, above the smaller text “ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU”. Further up, white text reads “UANG SEMIR BEKAS BOS PETRAL” and “PUISI DAN JURNALISME AMARZAN LOEBIS”.

The central figure is a painted illustration of a man with light brown skin, dark hair parted to the side, and a white collared shirt. He is shown from the chest up in a three-quarter profile facing left. His eyes are closed and his lips are slightly pursed. Directly behind him, a dark grey shadow is cast onto the background. The shadow’s profile matches the man's head and neck, but it features an elongated, pointed nose extending horizontally to the left.
